The '''Republic transport ship''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] around [[3653 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RepublicTransportAttacked-TORToP1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Republic transport ambushed by a Sith warship]]
These gray [[Transport/Legends|transports]] were oblong with smoothly rounded hull adorned with blue accent markings. A defensive [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] was mounted on the dorsal surface of each ship and large [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] ran along the surface of both sides of the vessel. The propulsion system consisted of two large drive engines.

==History==
In the days before the opening of the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]] started appearing on the edge of the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]], not knowing its origins the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sent a diplomatic convoy, lead by a Republic transport ship with a small [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] escort, to investigate; The fleet, belonging to the resurgent [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], held position as the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] wanted the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] to know the full extent of his military might before he attacked, the diplomats aboard the transport had just enough time to send images back before they were destroyed.

After the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dar'Nala]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Satele Shan]] were en route to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] to oversee the smooth withdrawal of [[Republic trooper|Republic troops]]. After passing through the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], the transport they were traveling in, the [[Envoy (Republic transport ship)|''Envoy'']], came under attack by a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|Sith warship]]. After seeing Master Dar'Nala captured by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces, Shan escaped the ship, with [[SP-99]] in tow, aboard an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. Though she retreated, at Master Dar'Nala's urging, to warn the Republic of the Sith's treachery, Shan vowed to return and rescue her former master.
